model: Measured triaxial ellipsoid, not a detailed terrain mesh
axesFrame: x is long Saturn-facing axis; y intermediate equatorial axis; z shortest polar axis. Camera source longitudes are west-positive and inverted when sampled into the east-positive map.

shapeSurvey.status: Updated Thomas and Helfenstein 2020 survey inspected; full text unavailable. Current PCK00011 agrees with published 2013 Methone axes.
shapeSurvey.meshDisposition: Buratti et al. 2019 explicitly identify Methone as an ellipsoidal exception to the released detailed PDS shape models.
